model.name: Chain-before-ship gate (no impl marker ships without a Requirement chain)
model.description: A chain-before-ship GATE that makes code-before-scenario IMPOSSIBLE by construction: trace:audit:strict + a pre-commit hook HARD-FAIL the build when a NEW [impl:uuid] marker on src has no linked Requirement chain (the marker's Impl unit must resolve AND be reachable Requirement->UseCase->Class->Method->Impl). It is DELTA-scoped - only NEW chain-less impls fail; pre-existing legacy chain-less markers are deferred/reported (no false-red), same delta-not-absolute discipline as the R27.2 INV2 gate. The detection reuses R27.5's marker-has-chain audit (no duplicate logic); R29.2 is the ENFORCEMENT that blocks the ship. This ends the retroactive-#126 tax (4x this session: R26.6/R27.1/R27.3/R29.1) structurally, not by 'try harder'.

acceptanceCriteria.text: trace:audit:strict + a pre-commit hook HARD-FAIL the build when a NEW [impl:uuid] marker on src has no linked Requirement chain (marker's Impl unit resolves AND is reachable Requirement->UseCase->Class->Method->Impl).
DELTA not absolute: ONLY new chain-less impls fail; pre-existing legacy chain-less markers are deferred/reported (no false-red) - same delta-vs-absolute discipline as R27.2 INV2.
The gate runs at PRE-COMMIT (block before the commit lands) AND in CI (ci:gates), so code-before-chain is caught at the earliest point.
Detection REUSES R27.5's marker-has-chain audit (Axis 4) - no duplicate audit logic; R29.2 is the enforcement layer.

A NEW impl marker with no Requirement chain -> RED build; a fully-chained impl -> GREEN; a legacy chain-less marker -> reported, not failed. Verified against the 4 retroactive-#126 cases as regression fixtures.
